chapter: Founding the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band
title: Balancing orthodontics with touring
summary: His orthodontic practice and a coverage group of colleagues let him go away for weeks.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: How did you balance that with your work life?

It worked out fine because as an orthodontist you don’t see your patients — you see one today and then the next appointment is three weeks away. And also some of us who had graduated from Columbia formed a cover group so that if somebody was sick or wanted to take a vacation we would cover the emergencies of that — there were six of us who formed this group. So I could go away for two and three weeks. It took a lot of doing because I had to almost see all of my patients before I left and then when I got back —
